text:
You will be pure:

three dresses,

an alms bowl.

You will be good:

the cheek,

then the other cheek for them to slap.

You will be strong:

your life,

then the other life in which you will become a god.

You will be humble as a pebble,

as a squab breaking from the egg.

You will be what you must be

for some truth,

for some love,

for some invisible order.

And you will be rewarded,

beast of burden and dreams.

And you will be punished,

animal loaded with stones

and with nothing.

You will never be yourself.

translation.title: Future
translation.editorial_note: The repeated future tense is kept as both prophecy and sentence.
